questions.stem: Where do you see when an import semantic model last refreshed and whether the refresh failed?
questions.explanation: A semantic model's refresh history lists each scheduled and on-demand refresh with its status and details.

questions.stem: At Fernway, what does refreshing the Direct Lake semantic model do after the nightly load?

options.text: It imports a full copy of the table into the model
It reframes the model to the latest version of the Delta table, a metadata operation that doesn't copy the data

questions.explanation: For Direct Lake, a refresh (framing) points the model at the latest table version. It's quick and cheap because no data is imported.

questions.stem: The semantic model must refresh right after the pipeline that loads its data finishes, not at a fixed time. What do you add?

options.text: A Semantic model refresh activity at the end of the pipeline
A second schedule an hour later

questions.explanation: The Semantic model refresh activity refreshes a model as a pipeline step, so it runs only after the load succeeds.

questions.stem: An import semantic model's scheduled refresh has failed several nights in a row, and now it doesn't run at all. What happened?

options.text: The capacity was paused by Microsoft
Power BI deactivated the schedule after repeated consecutive failures; fix the cause and turn the schedule back on
The refresh moved to Direct Lake by itself

questions.explanation: After four consecutive failures Power BI deactivates the refresh schedule. Check the refresh history for the error, fix it, and re-enable the schedule.
